sections.heading: Overview
sections.markdown:
# LSIP.JK — house coverage rates it BUY

Signal: the South Research division published coverage (v4) with a 12-month target of Rp4,688.0 against Rp1,560.0 (expected total return 206.7%). Why now: the rating crossed the BUY band on the engine's probability-weighted target.

Archetype guess: commodity_capex_turnaround · method card: per fund record routing for Plantations (palm oil).

Sharpest questions for a thesis:
- Both sources cited for the claim that GAPKI locates the loss in smallholder estates say the opposite of a smallholder-only loss: S24 has the chairman saying the impact is already felt by industry players (pelaku industri
- The 0.758 realisation is held flat for ten years although the domestic price it proxies is set off a moving policy wedge: the 9M-2026 dollar ASP was 856.9 USD/t, flat against 858.1 in FY2025, while the benchmark rose 11%
- Section 3 argues the World Bank replaced its palm-oil series from January 2026 so pre-2026 averages are not homogeneous [S15 p.3], the same point used to justify the calibration gap. Section 4 then calls the 1,150 anchor

Regime stance vs the macro desk is UNASSESSED: IDEATION/CONSTRUCT sets WITH / NEUTRAL / AGAINST before any deep-dive. Fast-disqualify checks and the thesis itself follow the full analyst -> Bear -> Judge law.
